svg.aria-label: From an API object to a series: 1. Watch: The Deployment lists and watches the API server for the object kinds it supports by default, cluster-wide. 2. Count: Each object becomes gauge or info series, such as kube_pod_status_phase or kube_node_status_allocatable. 3. Scrape: Prometheus scrapes the 8080 port through a ServiceMonitor whose job is kube-state-metrics. Honored labels keep each object's own namespace. 4. Self: Its own health is on port 8081: list and watch errors. The chart's KubeStateMetrics rules read those series.
